pictures.scene: Jan Both, An Italianate Landscape with Travellers on a Path - the rider on his mule with the boy walking beside him on the sunlit track and the pack train coming on behind them with the sheep grazing beyond, the tall tree standing over the road and the warm evening sky filling the height of it, a song of ascents, blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in His ways
pictures.name: pd_both_wegen

pictures.scene: Frans Snyders, Fruit Stall - the heaped baskets of white and black grapes, the bowls of raspberries and currants, the plums and quinces and pears and the cut melons piled up together on the bench and under it, for when you eat the fruit of your labor, blessings and prosperity will be yours
pictures.name: pd_snyders_vrucht

pictures.scene: Jan Mijtens, Govert van Slingelandt with his wife Christina van Beveren and their two sons - the father in his crimson cloak standing under the great tree, the mother in white satin seated with the baby on her lap, and the elder boy in blue at her knee holding up a bunch of grapes to her hand, your wife will be like a fruitful vine flourishing within your house, your sons like olive shoots sitting around your table, in this way indeed shall blessing come to the man who fears the LORD
pictures.name: pd_mijtens_gezin

pictures.scene: Gerrit Berckheyde, Gezicht op de Gouden Bocht in de Herengracht - the long row of fine brick houses standing along the quay in the clear morning light with the people walking under them and the boat lying on the still water, and the wide blue sky open above the whole street, may the LORD bless you from Zion, that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life
pictures.name: pd_berckheyde_voorspoed

pictures.scene: Ferdinand Georg Waldmuller, Grossmutters Geburtstag - the old woman in her red headscarf taking the gifts her laughing grandson holds up to her while her daughter stands behind them with a hand on her shoulder, that you may see your children's children, peace be upon Israel
pictures.name: pd_waldmuller_kleinkind

lines.text: Blessed are all who fear the LORD,
For when you eat the fruit of your labor,
blessings and prosperity will be yours.
Your wife will be like a fruitful vine
In this way indeed shall blessing come
to the man who fears the LORD.
May the LORD bless you from Zion,
that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem
all the days of your life,
